tagline: Global leader in information management services trusted by 240,000+ customers across 61 countries
hero_kpi_rationale: Physical storage revenue is the historical and structural pillar of IRM, representing more than 58% of revenue and fueled by a stable, recurring installed base, driving robust organic growth of 9.6% in 2025.
company_description: Iron Mountain Incorporated is a global leader in information management services, and is trusted by more than 240,000 customers in 61 countries. It also includes approximately 95% of the Fortune 1000, to help unlock value and intelligence from their assets through services that transcend the physical and digital worlds. Their broad range of solutions address their information management, digital transformation, information security, data center and asset lifecycle management (ALM) needs. Their longstanding commitment to safety, security, sustainability and innovation in support of our customers underpins everything we do. We currently serve customers across an array of market verticals commercial, legal, financial, healthcare, technology, life sciences, energy, business services, entertainment and government organizations. They are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (the NYSE) and are a constituent of the Standard & Poor's 500 Index, the Morgan Stanley Capital International (MSCI) REIT index and the FTSE EPRA Nareit Global Real Estate Index. risks.title: Restructuring and Transformation Costs
risks.summary: Restructuring costs related to the Matterhorn project are significant but in the concluding phase, with decreasing impact expected.
risks.score_rationale: Restructuring costs related to Project Matterhorn totaled $574.4 million since 2022, with $195.9 million in 2025. Although significant, the project is complete, which reduces future risk.

risks.title: Currency Fluctuations
risks.summary: Currency fluctuations generated substantial net losses in 2025, particularly on intercompany positions between subsidiaries.
risks.score_rationale: Net foreign exchange losses of $105.6 million in 2025, primarily related to GBP/EUR vs USD variations. Significant exposure due to international presence in 61 countries.

risks.title: Technology Dependence and Cybersecurity
risks.summary: The company is highly dependent on technology for its data center and document management operations, creating increased exposure to security risks.
risks.score_rationale: Data infrastructure and information management systems are critical for 240,000 customers. Vulnerability to cybersecurity risks, technical outages and high maintenance costs.

risks.title: Increased Competition in Digital Services
risks.summary: Digital transition and emergence of alternative cloud solutions threaten traditional revenue models.
risks.score_rationale: Fragmented market with growing competition from new entrants and cloud providers. Risk of technological substitution for traditional physical storage services.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks and Compliance
risks.summary: Compliance required with multiple and evolving data protection and privacy standards in jurisdictions of presence.
risks.score_rationale: Subject to strict regulations (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.) in 61 countries. Potentially high impact on operational costs and liability in case of non-compliance.

risks.title: Dependence on Economic Growth in Addressable Markets
risks.summary: Exposure to global economic cycle, particularly in financial, healthcare and insurance sectors.
risks.score_rationale: Revenue growth linked to economic cycles and demand for information services in regulated segments (finance, healthcare, insurance). Economic slowdown could impact volumes.

risks.title: Acquisition Integration and Performance
risks.summary: Risk of integration and performance dilution when assimilating acquired ALM activities.
risks.score_rationale: Recent acquisitions in the ALM segment generating $87.5 million in additional revenue. Risk of not achieving expected synergies and complex operational integration.
